The Tracking Generators work in two different ways. depending upon the original source:

POSITIVE ONLY / If the input goes from 0 to 63 (such as keyboard or envelope) the 0 input level appears at POINT 1. Setting the output to 0 results in 0.

TRACKING GENERATOR OUTPUT from a Positive input such as a KEYBOARD or ENVELOFE

POSITIVE /NEGATIVE / If the input goes negative and positive (such as an LFO or Bender) then O input level appears at POINT 3—in the middie. Setting a point to 31 results in 0 output, below 31 is negative and above 31 is positive.

TRACKING GENERATOR OUTPUT

rrom a Positive/sNeqgative input such as an LFO or BENDER

ideas Two hip things that can be done with Tracking Generators are:

1) With a Triangle wave from an LFO (positive / negative input) as an input, setting Points 2 and 4 towards the extremes will result in an output closer to a sine wave.

2) A vanable control such as a Pedal or Velocity (positive inputs) can be turned into a switch with a Tracking Generator, by setting all of the points to 0 except the highest one. Only near the maximum input will anything other than 0 come out of the Tracking Generator. You can patch the Pedal somewhere else in addition to the Tracking Generator. giving you gradual control of one function with the full range of the pedal, while switching on a second function only at the top of the pedal.
